 Advocates for R-1
 Ms. Mrinalini Sen, St
 for Dda
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Sudhir Kumar Jain
 Order
1. The present application is filed under section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 for condonation of delay of 481 days in filing the appeal.
2. The counsel for the appellant stated that the impugned judgment was passed on 22.10.2022 but the appellant was not aware of the passing of the judgment as she was not residing in the village.
The appellant came to know from another co-sharer about the enhanced compensation.

Thereafter,
after taking legal advice, the appellant filed the present appeal.
The appellant could manage the finances for professional charges, including court fees, only on 04.05.2024.
3. The counsel for the appellant prayed for condonation of delay.
The delay in filing the present appeal is neither intentional nor deliberate.

4. The respective counsel for the respondents stated that the court may pass suitable orders regarding the condonation of delay but the appellant is not entitled to claim interest for the said period.

sentences.text: Issue notice.
10. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, Standing Counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondent no.1/UOI.

Ms. Mrinalini Sen, Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent no. 2/DDA,
accepts notice.
11. The appeal is accordingly admitted.

12. List the present appeal in due course in the category of 'Regular Matters' along with other connected appeal.
